note: auto_approve is ON: posts that pass every automatic check are approved by the system and go out at their slot; a tap on a card's red cross before the slot stops one. A post that fails a check is sent to Telegram marked with what failed and only goes out if you approve it. tiktok_packages: after a Reel is published it is also sent to Telegram with its caption, ready to upload to TikTok by hand. Set auto_approve false to pause. station_footage: false = no TV station's footage in our Reels (their broadcast edits, banners and tickers are not ours); a clip the computer fetches is deleted unused. Set true to allow it again.
